limits: Graph transport has explicit diagnostic activation; gameplay remains synchronous.
Native route preparation and physics remain owner-only; the complete route function is not a worker entry.
Reader ceilings bound supported retained copied-snapshot/transport storage, not total engine memory or transient owner generation/construction.
Deadline and completion wall budgets are cooperative; OS preemption or one owner operation may cross them.
One execution context and no suspended context pool; exhaustion returns resource_limited with reason rather than unreachable.
No sanitizer/race-detector, new visual review, request-to-actor-commit latency or speedup claim.
